nodes.notes: REQUIRED: select Header Auth credential. Header name X-AllBarka-Webhook-Secret. Keep secret server-side.

parameters.content:
## Website AI — same Groq account/model
Select Webhook Header Auth credential (X-AllBarka-Webhook-Secret = backend N8N_AI_WEBHOOK_SECRET). Select your existing Groq Header Auth credential on Website AI Brain. Credential references are intentionally blank in this Git-safe export.

Only the commerce server calls this URL. Configure N8N_AI_WEBHOOK_URL using the Production URL. Browser calls /api/chat. No WhatsApp sends, phone sessions, order writes or Slack notifications on this branch.

20s Groq / 22s backend / 30s browser deadlines.

parameters.content:
## Canonical website orders -> existing Order_Control
Select Header Auth (X-AllBarka-Webhook-Secret = backend N8N_WEBHOOK_SECRET). Verify the Google credential, spreadsheet and Order_Control columns.

Production URL -> N8N_ORDER_WEBHOOK_URL. Server must require the secret and use its durable outbox retry worker. Ack only after Sheet write; duplicate event skips status edits.

This Sheet lookup/append is not an atomic ledger: serialize backend dispatch and audit duplicates. Firestore remains authoritative. This branch sends no customer WhatsApp message and does not validate HMAC signatures. See guide for remaining shipping/stock/status blockers.
